title: The event header photo is cropped to the host's focus point instead of letterboxed

source.ref: Owner, 2026-10-30: the event header should be cropped with the focus chooser. A portrait flyer sat letterboxed with lavender fill beside it.

verify.note: Fails on main, where the cover art is object-fit contain over a blurred backdrop. Reads the cover CSS and the focal-point seam.

detail: FqEventCover now fills the frame with object-fit cover and applies events.theme.coverFocus through eventCoverFocusStyle. The blurred backdrop and the measured-aspect frame are gone, so a portrait flyer crops to the picked point.
